name: Crusoe
h1: Crusoe ARR: ~$2.2B From Wasted Energy to AI Real Estate.
intro: Crusoe started by burning otherwise-flared natural gas to mine Bitcoin, then pivoted into one of the largest AI data center developers in the United States. Every reported revenue, funding and contract number is collected below, each traced back to a public source.

modelTitle: How Leased Data Center Shells Became $2.2B.
modelParagraphs: Crusoe no longer makes most of its money selling wasted energy — it makes it leasing AI data center capacity. The anchor contract is Abilene, Texas: the flagship site of OpenAI's Stargate build-out, leased through Oracle, with the first 980,000 sq ft / 200+ MW phase energized in the first half of 2025 and 64,000 NVIDIA GB200 GPUs expected on site by 2026. Oracle's Stargate commitments are what turn a construction project into a multi-year, contracted revenue stream.

The balance sheet, not the P&L, carries the model. Crusoe and Blue Owl Capital formed a $15B joint venture with Primary Digital to fund Abilene's second phase, and closed a separate $3.4B debt deal for the site. Around the edges the company still runs its original climate-aligned energy business and managed GPU cloud, but the 2026 forecast of ~$2.2B is essentially a data center leasing business measured against a $30B-plus valuation target in pre-IPO talks.
revenueMix: Long-term contracted capacity, anchored by Oracle's Stargate lease at Abilene.
Flared-gas power generation and the original mining business, now a minority of revenue.
Crusoe Cloud rents GPU capacity on Crusoe-operated infrastructure.

faqs.a: Crusoe's 2026 revenue forecast, presented to investors, is roughly $2.2 billion. That follows a projected ~$2 billion for 2025 and $276 million of actual 2024 revenue — a figure that reflects data center leasing commitments rather than classic subscription ARR.

faqs.q: How Did Crusoe Grow From $30M to $2B in Two Years?
faqs.a: The pivot from flared-gas Bitcoin mining to AI data centers. The first AI leasing contracts landed in 2024 ($276M revenue), and the Abilene campus — the anchor site of OpenAI and Oracle's Stargate project — energized its first 200+ MW phase in the first half of 2025, driving projected 2025 revenue to about $2 billion.

faqs.q: What Is Crusoe's Role in Stargate?
faqs.a: Crusoe built and operates the Abilene, Texas campus that serves as the first Stargate site. It is developing the campus to 1.2 GW of total capacity, with 64,000 NVIDIA GB200 GPUs expected by 2026, leased to OpenAI through Oracle.

faqs.q: What Is Crusoe's Valuation and How Much Has It Raised?
faqs.a: A $1.375 billion Series E co-led by Mubadala in October 2025 valued Crusoe at roughly $10 billion, up from $2.8 billion at its December 2024 Series D. Total equity funding exceeds $2.5 billion, with a further $15B joint venture and $3.4B of debt financing for Abilene, and a $30-40B valuation reportedly discussed in pre-IPO talks.

No. It is a 2026 revenue forecast presented to investors, dominated by contracted data center leasing. It is classified here as Reported, not Disclosed — Crusoe has not published audited run-rate figures, and leasing revenue is recognized differently from subscription ARR.
